recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以各階段紅血球母細胞為主（紅系增生），可見數顆晚期紅血球母細胞具兩個大小相等、並排的深染圓形核（雙核），另有核形不規則的細胞，是 CDA II 的典型骨髓表現。
features: Marked erythroid predominance with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation
Several late erythroblasts with two equal-sized, adjacent round dense nuclei (binucleation)
Early erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with granular chromatin
Occasional cells with irregular or lobulated nuclear contours
Few granulocytic precursors; background red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation, including basophilic normoblasts with deeply blue cytoplasm and numerous polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts. Several late erythroblasts contain two equal-sized, adjacent round nuclei, and occasional cells show irregular nuclear outlines. Granulocytic precursors are relatively sparse. Erythroid hyperplasia with equal-sized binucleate late erythroblasts is consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts connected by internuclear chromatin bridges, with binucleation less prominent.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with reactive erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia lacks significant binucleation and is associated with a brisk reticulocytosis.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic neoplasm or acute erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: These show dysplasia in other lineages, megaloblastoid change, clonal abnormalities (e.g., TP53) and, in erythroid leukemia, many pronormoblasts.
